now.title: Thunderbolts*
now.text: Alexei takes a liking to Bob Reynolds after picking the group up in the desert, and cheers when Bob is unveiled as the Sentry. When Valentina turns the Sentry against them, Alexei charges in first and is knocked into a wall, but the team ends up saving Bob from the Void together.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Alexei takes a liking to. Together the team saves him from the Void.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A warm teammate who cheers Bob as the Sentry, then helps save him.

proposed.text: Alexei first meets Bob when Valentina unveils him at the Watchtower as the Sentry, and he loves the name. When Valentina turns the Sentry against them, Alexei charges in first and is knocked into a wall, but the team ends up saving Bob from the Void together.

changes.evidence: In Thunderbolts*, Bob is not picked up in the desert: after drawing O.X.E. fire he crash-lands and is captured and taken to the Watchtower, while Alexei's limo picks up only Yelena, Walker and Ghost. Alexei first meets Bob at the Watchtower, where he admires the name Sentry, then charges and is punched into a wall.

now.title: Thunderbolts*
now.text: Mel is Valentina de Fontaine's assistant, and Bucky Barnes tries to turn her against her boss. She refuses to testify, but she quietly tips him off to track Valentina's phone.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Valentina's assistant. Won't testify for Bucky, but tips him off to track Valentina's phone.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A congressman who tries to turn Mel against her boss, Valentina.

proposed.text: Mel is Valentina de Fontaine's assistant, and Bucky Barnes tries to turn her against her boss. She refuses to testify, but she quietly tells him to track her phone.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Valentina's assistant. Won't testify for Bucky, but tells him to track her phone.

changes.evidence: In Thunderbolts*, when Bucky pleads with Mel for something, she advises him to track HER phone and hangs up; Bucky then tracks Mel's phone (she is riding with Valentina) to find the convoy. It is not Valentina's phone.

now.title: VisionQuest#1
now.text: The White Vision keeps F.R.I.D.A.Y. and other Stark A.I.s inside his Mindspace, where she takes the human form of Allison Hogan, the woman she was modeled on. She becomes a close friend who helps him in his search to understand humanity.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The White Vision. Keeps F.R.I.D.A.Y. in his Mindspace as a close friend.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old A.I., a close friend in Vision's Mindspace.

proposed.text: The White Vision keeps F.R.I.D.A.Y. and other Stark A.I.s inside his Mindspace, where she looks after his social development. She becomes a close friend who helps him in his search to understand humanity.

split.title: VisionQuest#3
split.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. reveals that the A.I.s' human forms in Vision's Mindspace are based on real people, hers on Allison Hogan.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The White Vision, in whose Mindspace F.R.I.D.A.Y. wears Allison Hogan's face.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old A.I., a close friend in Vision's Mindspace with Allison Hogan's face.

changes.evidence: In VisionQuest #1 (No Strings) F.R.I.D.A.Y. oversees Vision's social development; nothing says her avatar copies a real woman. In #3 (Reboot) F.R.I.D.A.Y. reveals the A.I.s' human avatars are based on actual individuals, and Allison Hogan's name is sourced to #3 (her background as Howard's 'Gal Friday' follows in #4).

now.title: VisionQuest
now.text: Lisa Molinari is Tommy's best friend and love interest. They escape a transfer to a psychiatric hospital together and spend a year as street thieves, and he later frees her from Jocasta's nanobot control.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Lisa's best friend and love interest. Frees her from Jocasta's control.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Tommy's best friend and love interest, a fellow street thief.

proposed.text: Lisa Molinari is Tommy's best friend and love interest. They escape a transfer to a psychiatric hospital together and spend a year as street thieves.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Lisa's best friend and love interest, a fellow street thief.

split.title: VisionQuest#6
split.text: In Madripoor, Jocasta infects Lisa with a prototype nanobot, and Tommy uses his powers to shut it down and save her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Lisa's best friend, who frees her from Jocasta's nanobot.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Tommy's best friend, whom he frees from Jocasta's nanobot.

changes.evidence: Jocasta infecting Lisa with a nanobot and Tommy deactivating it happens in VisionQuest #6 (Deadlock), not at the series start. (The bus escape is a #2 flashback of events a year earlier; left in place as backstory.)

now.title: Thor: Ragnarok
now.text: Valkyrie and the Hulk become drinking buddies while living on Sakaar. She and Bruce Banner escape together with Thor and fight Hela's forces on Asgard.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Hulk's drinking buddy on Sakaar. Escapes with Bruce.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Valkyrie's drinking buddy on Sakaar. Escapes with her.

proposed.text: Valkyrie and the Hulk are friends and sparring partners on Sakaar. She and Bruce Banner escape together with Thor and fight Hela's forces on Asgard.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Hulk's friend and sparring partner on Sakaar. Escapes with Bruce.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Valkyrie's friend and sparring partner on Sakaar. Escapes with her.

changes.evidence: In Thor: Ragnarok, Valkyrie visits the Hulk's quarters and they playfully spar; the film shows them as friends and sparring partners. Valkyrie drinks heavily, but nothing shows the Hulk drinking with her.

owner_calls.question: The text and both card lines call the Bifrost sword 'Hofund'. On screen in Thor: Ragnarok it seems to be just 'the sword' (Hela: 'Where's the sword? That sword is the key to opening the Bifrost'); Hofund looks like a wiki or reference-book name. Also, the card line on Heimdall's card is broken ('Usurper Heimdall steals Hofund from and hides Asgard's people from.'). Swap the name?
options: Text: 'Heimdall steals the sword that opens the Bifrost so Hela cannot use it, and he hides the fleeing people of Asgard in the mountains. He keeps them safe from her until Thor comes home to fight her.' Card on Heimdall: 'Usurper whose Bifrost sword Heimdall steals, and from whom he hides Asgard's people.' Card on Hela: 'Gatekeeper who steals the Bifrost sword and hides Asgard's people from Hela.'
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom: 'Hofund, often simply referred as the Bifrost Sword'; the Ragnarok quote on its page says only 'the sword'. I could not confirm the name is never said, so this is not a firm change.
